standard.summary: 周期性压缩低能量 rank 通道。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Periodically compresses the low-energy rank channels.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 周期性压缩低能量 rank 通道。与实验探针里的「SmartRank 动态区间」(smart_rank_*) 是不同后端键。

advanced_en.principle: Periodically compresses low-energy rank channels. This is a different backend key from the "SmartRank dynamic range" (smart_rank_*) in the experimental probes.
